name: Jordan Bennett
role: News Editor, Time, Seasonal Events, Data & Social Impact
bio: Jordan Bennett is the News Editor for time, seasonal events and data at Fresh Calendars News. Jordan leads coverage of daylight saving time and clock changes, time-zone rules, solstices and equinoxes, movable dates such as Easter, and retail-calendar events such as Black Friday. Jordan's data-led explainers document the dataset, period, geography and method behind each table, check dates and times against official timekeeping and astronomical sources, and separate what the data shows from what it cannot prove.
